select_t0_universe_live.reason: uses the current snapshot cumulative amount and elapsed-session fraction only

fetch_yahoo_5m_quotes.reason: fullamt[date] is computed from the complete day before the date's opening rows are emitted

convert_june_to_quotes.reason: full-day amount selects the universe before all intraday decision rows are emitted

build_t0_replay_quotes_from_minute_data.reason: liquidity threshold is evaluated from each timestamp's cumulative amount/session fraction

safeResearchPath.gate: previous-day ADV >= full-day floor OR current cumulative amount >= floor * elapsed-session fraction

overlapDiagnostic.interpretation: descriptive selection effect only; it is not a strategy-PnL correction

baselineImpact.reason: the ungated raw 60-day archive does not cover the original full ~500-ETF universe, so -0.11%/+1.61% cannot be honestly restated
baselineImpact.decision: treat prior baseline levels as method-contaminated diagnostics; rebuild before future opening/intraday claims
